notes.title: Version 6.0.1
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]The plant on first floor had a graphical glitch before meeting the little girl for the first time, this was fixed
[*]Sometimes portraits weren't removed properly, this was fixed.
[*]Stamina bar wasn't removed from Coward ending, this was fixed.[/list]

notes.title: Version 6.0
notes.content:
[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Zoomed Field of View closer
[*]Improved the way bust graphics are shown and changed when multiple characters are talking[/list]

[b]Engine [/b]

[list][*]Updated corescript to 1.7.0 (was 1.5.0)[/list]

[b]Messages[/b]

[list][*]Added Message Log, accessible from the in game menu
[*]Added ability to hide Messages
[*]Much added message functionality, such as ability to fast forward the and set automatic text progression[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]

[list][*]Numerous optimizations to scripts[/list]

[b]Quality of Life[/b]

[list][*]If your mentality reaches the point that you pee yourself, you get the Despairing Incontinence status which is clearly visible to tell you something changed.[/list]

[b]Options[/b]

[list][*]You can now enable/disable tutorials from options[/list]

[b]Scares[/b]

[list][*]The creepy portrait is now permanently in a twisted state after meeting the little girl for the first time
[*]The plant in first floor of House of Fun changes after meeting the little girl for the first time[/list]

[b]Tutorials[/b]

[list][*]Tutorials have been completely redesigned.[/list]

[b]UI[/b]

[list][*]The ingame UI has been completely redesigned, for more sleek look[/list]

notes.title: Version 5.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Interacting with the pile of pink oozing mass from a weird direction instead of down could lead the ghost sequence to lockup, this has been fied
[*]Achievements work again[/list]

notes.title: Halloween Event 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Halloween Limited time loot event![/h1]

We have prepared a fun temporary time event for you all; Halloween Limited Time Loot Event!

During this event, you will find candy bucket on the table near the entrance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41210793/c16a3aae1a0e1a95058b5f75d537a342b02b4e33.png[/img]

This bucket contains one chocolate bar and one unique item; Candy. Candy restores 20 HP and SA when eaten. 

[h2]The event will run until November 5th[/h2]

At this point, the bucket will disappear from the game and you can no longer obtain the chocolate bar and candy, so don't miss out on obtaining useful healing items; play the game today!

[h3]We also recently updated the game 5.1 version[/h3]

To see all the changes, visit this changelog update found here

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1754760/view/5964477584857112813

notes.title: Version 5.1
notes.content:
[b]Audio[/b]

[list][*]Letter sounds are now more silent and less frequent[/list]

[b]Engine[/b]

[list][*]Updated corescript to 1.5 (was 1.4.4)[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]

[list][*]Numerous optimizations to scripts[/list]

[b]Tutorials[/b]

[list][*]Control tutorials now automatically recognize if you're using a gamepad or using keyboard and show the correct buttons automatically[/list]

notes.title: Version 5.0
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Added workarounds to help prevent the game being stuck after saying "Tokyo 1985" at the intro on certain systems
[*]If Stamina was 100 and you transitioned to new map, the stamina meter was stuck on screen. This has been fixed.[/list]

[b]Engine[/b]

[list][*]Updated corescript to 1.4.4 (was 1.4.3)
[*]Exit from game now terminates the game differently to work better on all platforms
[*]NWJS updated to the latest version (0.62)[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Bust graphics are now no longer too bright and affected by Bloom
[*]Increased Bloom
[*]Increased saturation
[*]Increased contrast
[*]Added color grading[/list]

[b]Mac[/b]

[list][*]Game now support Mac systems[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]

[list][*]Numerous optimizations to scripts[/list]

[b]UI[/b]

[list][*]Completely revamped the stamina UI[/list]

notes.title: Version 4.2.1
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Temporarily removed support for animated mouse cursor, as this could cause game crashes.
[*]Removed a check at start, which could cause game to not load properly[/list]

[b]Optimization[/b]

[list][*]Added support for more graphics cards
[*]Some tweaks to NWJS settings to enable more gpu memory buffer and rasterization for better FPS[/list]

notes.title: Version 4.2
notes.content:
[b]Bugfix[/b]

[list][*]Pictures weren't localized due to script complications, this has been fixed.[/list]

[b]CoreScript[/b]

[list][*]Updated CoreScript from 1.4.0 to 1.4.3[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]

[list][*]Put a book on the table instead of the burnt note, to help players not miss this important item needed for the best ending of the game[/list]

[b]Graphics[/b]

[list][*]Changed the way FullScreen options behave[/list]

[b]Localization[/b]

[list][*]Added French localization[/list]

[b]Messages[/b]

[list][*]Added extra padding to the end of messages to prevent certain letters in some languages to be cutoff[/list]

[b]Optimizations[/b]

[list][*]Preloading some audio resources for better gameplay experience
[*]Numerous performance optimizations in scripts[/list]

notes.title: Differences to the original Game Jam entry
notes.content:
[h1]Difference to the original version[/h1]

As some may know, this game was originally done for a game jam where it was a finalist, reaching top 20 out of 110 games.

However, Traumatic Edition changes the game and adds new content and I wanted to make this post aimed to people who have played the jam entry or seen gameplay of the original to see what's different.

[h2]Traumatic Edition changes[/h2]

[list][*]New intro
[*]Two new endings
[*]New area to explore, Haunted Mansion
[*]Stamina System
[*]New Chaser
[*]Vastly improved Chaser AI
[*]Various quality of life improvements
[*]Achievements
[*]And more!
[/list]

[h3]Wishlist the game today![/h3]
